identity.title: B4 — finite conditional nine-role native receipt coordinator
identity.objective: One bounded offline campaign of one or two explicitly selected synthetic cases from cold-verified B2/B3 native receipts; route nine role slots per case into real conditional native receipt consumers, persist intent prior to each attempt, reconcile interruptions without duplicate task execution, seal and independently cold-verify complete denominators and handoffs.
